title: 第十六章 哥布林-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    爻雪果断放弃了第一个方案，毕竟现在就算是把她给卖了，也根本就拿不出这一万枚晶核来，至于第二个方案，找到秘境核心。

    根据系统所说，只要能够找我系统核心，那就算是初步彻底掌握了这个秘境。

    秘境核心就像是一把钥匙，只要有秘境核心，就能够随意的打开或者关闭秘境，也就是说，如果爻雪拿到了秘境核心，她就有资格直接将这个秘境关闭。

    【宿主，由于本次任务的难度过高，所以本系统已经向诸神申请了补偿，无论这个任务成功与否，该秘境都将归你所有，以及游戏商店免费升级一次。】

    看在补偿还不错的份上，爻雪的心情顿时好了不少。

    有了异能在，爻雪的胆子打了不少，所以她决定自己先进去看看里面到底是个什么情况，实在不行的话再出来。

    “系统，这个秘境如果放任不管的话，最多需要多少时间，里面的生物才会跑出来？”

    听到爻雪这样问，系统如实回答道：

    【如果再无人干预的情况下，2级秘境的禁锢大概再过二十四小时就会完全消失，里面的生物就会通过秘境通道彻底降临到这个世界之中】

    二十四小时，这个结果比她预想中的结果要好上不少，她还以为只有几个小时呢。

    【宿主，对于人类而言，秘境里面充满了危险，但同时也是机遇，我跟你说哦，这个2级秘境里面可是有不少的好东西呢，我们这次进入之后多带回去一点，到时候治疗药剂，回复药剂就都能够制造出来了。】

    “我记得我的身份只是一个NPC把，制作药剂好像是药剂师的活。”

    爻雪有些无语的说道。

    她算是发现了，这个绑定自己的系统是真的废物，一开始只是一个面板不说，后来进化之后也仅仅是能够开口说话和发布任务，其余的什么忙都帮不上。

    然而，系统似乎没有听出爻雪话里的意思，以及喋喋不休的说道：

    【宿主是觉得自己制作不出来吗？不要担心，在绑定本系统的瞬间，系统就对你的身体进行了改造，将所有生活职业的知识全部都灌输到了你的大脑之中了】

    闻言，爻雪瞪大眼睛，惊讶道：“什么时候的事？我怎么一点感觉都没有？”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yaoxue decisively gave up the first plan. After all, even if she were sold now, she still wouldn't be able to get the 10,000 crystal cores. As for the second plan, find the core of the secret realm.

​​According to the system, as long as I can find the core of the system, it will be considered as a preliminary and complete mastery of this secret realm.

The core of the secret realm is like a key. As long as there is the core of the secret realm, you can open or close the secret realm at will. In other words, if Yaoxue gets the core of the secret realm, she is qualified to close the secret realm directly.

[Host, because the difficulty of this mission is too high, this system has applied for compensation from the gods. Regardless of whether the mission is successful or not, the secret realm will be yours, and the game store will upgrade it once for free.】

Seeing that the compensation was not bad, Yaoxue's mood suddenly improved a lot.

With the supernatural power, Yaoxue's courage was greatly weakened, so she decided to go in first to see what was going on inside, and then come out if it didn't work.

"System, if this secret realm is left alone, how long will it take at most before the creatures inside will escape?"

Hearing Yaoxue ask this question, the system answered truthfully:

[If no one intervenes, the confinement of the level 2 secret realm will completely disappear in about twenty-four hours, and the creatures inside will completely descend into this world through the secret realm passage]

Twenty-four hours, this result was much better than she expected. She thought it was only a few hours.

【Host, for humans, the secret realm is full of dangers, but at the same time it is also an opportunity. Let me tell you, there are a lot of good things in this level 2 secret realm. We will bring back more after entering this time. By then, we will be able to produce healing potions and recovery potions.】

"I remember that my identity was just an NPC, and making potions seemed to be the job of a pharmacist."

Yaoxue said speechlessly.

She has finally discovered that the system that binds her is really useless. At first, it was just a panel. Later, after it evolved, it was only able to speak and issue tasks, and could not help with anything else.

However, the system didn’t seem to understand the meaning of Yaoxue’s words, and kept chattering:

【Does the host think that it cannot be made by itself?Don’t worry, the moment you bind this system, the system will transform your body and instill all the knowledge of life and profession into your brain]

Hearing this, Yaoxue's eyes widened and she asked in surprise: "When did it happen? Why don't I feel anything?"
